paragraphs: The XJ 5.0 V8 Supercharged uses the AJ133S — a 5.0-litre supercharged V8 petrol engine. It was fitted from 2009 to 2019 across the X351 generation, representing the flagship performance option in the XJ range alongside the naturally aspirated 5.0 V8 and the supercharged V6 models. The AJ133S is part of Jaguar's Gen III AJ-V8 family and shares the same timing chain tensioner design pattern as other JLR vehicles of this era. Jaguar XJ 5.0 V8 Supercharged Engine Compatibility The XJ 5.0 V8 Supercharged uses the AJ133S engine exclusively across its entire 2009–2019 production run. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the XJ 5.0 V8 Supercharged from 2023 to present. The AJ133S features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ133S V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ133S rebuild.
